title: A WARPIGS
paragraphs:
WarPigs Craft Kitchen was built on a love of barbecue, a respect for hard work, and a belief that great food brings people together.

What started as a backyard hobby quickly became a passion for competition barbecue, where I found an incredible community of pitmasters who were generous with their knowledge and pushed me to become a better cook. I'm especially grateful to mentors like Gary Park of G's Slow Smoked BBQ and Oscar Camacho of Camacho's Southern Style BBQ, whose guidance and friendship helped shape both my cooking and my approach to hospitality.
My journey has taken me from Northern California to the U.S. Army, through the South where I developed a deep appreciation for regional barbecue traditions, and back home to Sonoma County. Along the way, I discovered that the best meals aren't just about smoke and meat—they're about bringing people together around the table.
Today, WarPigs has grown into a full-service catering company, pop-up kitchen, and BBQ-to-go destination serving Sonoma County and beyond. Whether we're catering a wedding, feeding hundreds at a corporate event, or serving guests at one of our weekly pop-ups, our goal is always the same: serve food we're proud of and make every guest feel welcome.
Our style continues to evolve into what we call Modern Americana—traditional live-fire barbecue paired with fresh seasonal ingredients, bright flavors, and the diverse culinary influences that have shaped our journey.

More than anything, we hope WarPigs becomes a place where memories are made. A place friends meet after work, families gather around the table, and children one day bring their own families back to share the meals they grew up loving.
Thank you for being part of our story. We look forward to sharing many more meals with you.
